newsitem.title: UK: BA says discussing cargo fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: BA says discussing cargo fuel surcharge.

text.p: British Airways Plc's World Cargo division has not yet taken a decision on whether or not to apply a cargo fuel-surcharge, a BA spokeswoman said.
"The matter is still under discussion. No decision is expected today," she added.
Since last Friday, Lufthansa Cargo AG, KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV and Virgin Atlantic Cargo have announced such cargo surcharges starting during November.
Swissair has announced an increase in cargo tariffs to reflect the higher costs of jet-fuel.

Air France Cargo in announcing its decision said fuel costs had risen 40 percent between June and October this year. It added that in the nine months from January to September expenditure on fuel was 125 million francs higher than in the same 1995 period.
Industry sources say North American airlines are closely monitoring developments and if one carrier decides to apply a cargo surcharge, others are likely to quickly follow.
